name: blender-inspect
description: Depth, surface and topology inspection of Blender scenes: mesh defect audits, depth-revealing renders and depth-ordering reports read from the scene itself.

interface.shortDescription: Audit meshes and see depth in Blender scenes
interface.longDescription: Headless Blender tools that report mesh defects with locations, render matcap, depth, normal, AO and object-ID views, and state which object is in front in each view.
defaultPrompt: Render matcap and depth views of this model.
Which part is in front in the front view?
